purpose: Phase08 V06 defined synthetic noise stimulus only; generation is not execution evidence

noise.distribution: deterministic centered uniform pseudorandom white noise
noise.algorithm: xorshift32: x^=x<<13; x^=x>>17; x^=x<<5, uint32 mask after shifts; u=2*x/4294967295-1; subtract whole-clip mean; scale to source RMS / 10; Python round-to-even mixture quantization
noise.snrDefinition: 20*log10(RMS(original PCM) / RMS(quantized mixture minus original PCM)), over original full utterance frames
noise.window: Noise over every original utterance frame only. Optional transport pre/post-roll is separate and remains digital zero. No real-room/acoustic claim.

provenance: Derivatives of unchanged pinned local Windows Zira SAPI outputs from fixed public synthetic text. No human recordings, new voice/model, internet source or dependency. Original license/provenance limitations remain; WAVs are private and not redistributed.
limitations: 20 dB is the exact defined synthetic noise condition, not a standardized real-world moderate-noise rating.
No local accent, room acoustics, echo, device microphone noise or human recognition validation.
No ADB, virtual input, capture, transcription or command confirmation executed by this generator.
Original WAV files and public/private source manifests are not modified.
